text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It ended in a tie, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Is it... because Rice brings bad luck...? 
Maybe it really is better if I'm not on 
the team...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...No, because you told me... that Rice is 
needed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
For everyone's sake, I'll work even, 
harder...!
